text: Plate seven. The honeybee: Apis mellifera.
asr: Plate seven the honeybee a piece mellafura

text: Each eye is built from more than five thousand facets, and every one of them is a lens.
asr: Each eye is built from more than 5000 facets and every one of them is a lens

text: In flight, a row of tiny hooks locks the two wings into one.
And on the hind leg, a basket, for carrying pollen home.
A lifetime of such work makes a twelfth of a teaspoon of honey.
